messages:
tara_support: :warning: ACME reports compilation failures in their CI after yesterday's prod rollout. Copying their log and repro below.

customer_acme: Here's the failure — started after switching to 'rdm-codex-2' yesterday:

```bash
src/generator.ts:12:5 - error TS2304: Cannot find name 'createClient'.
12     const client = createClient(apiKey)
       ~~~~~~~
```

and the generated file (snippet) from the assistant:

```ts
// generated by assistant
import {init} from '@redwood/runtime'

export function makeClient(key: string) {
  return init(key)
}
```

We expected `import {createClient} from '@redwood/sdk'` and a default export. CI fails because name mismatch and missing types.

ben_eng: Thanks — can you attach the exact prompt and model version you used? Also what's the earliest commit where it worked?

customer_acme: Prompt attached (short): "Generate a TypeScript client wrapper for our SDK." Model: rdm-codex-2 @ 2026-03-15 04:12 UTC. Before rollout we used rdm-codex-1a and it compiled.

ryan_ml: :eyes: Likely a behavior drift where the model prefers init/create naming. Could be a change in generation priors after the fine-tune/rollout. We'll check model diffs. Meanwhile recommend pinning to rdm-codex-1a for that org.

tara_support: Customer is blocked — CI failing across branches. Can we do immediate pin or a rollback? They have a paid dedicated account and it's high priority.

deploy-bot: prod rollout rdm-codex-2 -> all regions completed at 1995004200

ben_eng: I'll open a quick repro repo and test prompt against rdm-codex-1a vs rdm-codex-2. If consistent, we'll add a regression test to the eval harness and push a routing rollback for that cohort.

ryan_ml: Also recommend a short prompt template change: explicitly request imports and exported names, e.g., "Include: import {createClient} from '@redwood/sdk'; export default function ...". I'll run a spec on our golden prompts to measure delta.

tara_support: Customer asked for ETA on a fix — can we give a temporary config: model_pin=rdm-codex-1a for their org?

ben_eng: Yes — infra can pin models per org. I'll start the pin and validate. ETA ~45m to confirm routing change and a repro run.

customer_acme: Thanks — we'll try the pin. Also saw a secondary failure: generated helpers use `any` and omit exported types causing lint errors. So two categories: compile-time missing symbol and style/type regressions.

ryan_ml: Noted. We'll prioritize behavioral regression checks (symbol naming, import patterns, export shapes) in the preflight for codegen rollouts. Adding to action items.

tara_support: Follow-ups: ben -> org pin + repro repo link; ryan -> regression delta report; tara -> customer comms and incident ticket. :thumbsup:

ben_eng: Created ticket INF-4239 and pushed a minimal repro to https://git.internal/repro-acme-codegen. Updating when pin completes.

customer_acme: Confirmed pin applied, CI resumed for a few jobs. Will report back if anything else crops up. Thanks.

ryan_ml: I'll post the regression diff once I finish the automated checks.

tara_support: Closing loop for now, keeping incident open until regression test merged.
